# truefoundry_models (Data Source)

Lists the models available on the TrueFoundry AI Gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All models on the gateway.
data "truefoundry_models" "all" {}

# Only the models of one provider account.
data "truefoundry_models" "azure_openai" {
  provider_account_fqn = truefoundry_provider_account.azure_openai.fqn
}

output "gateway_model_fqns" {
  value = [for m in data.truefoundry_models.all.models : m.fqn]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `provider_account_fqn` (String) Only return models of the provider account with this FQN.

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) Model integrations registered on the gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the model integration.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `model_id` (String) Provider model identifier.
- `model_types` (List of String) Model capabilities.
- `name` (String) Integration name.
- `provider_account_fqn` (String) FQN of the provider account the model belongs to.
